note: The first evening's dusk call (docs/future/13 section 2.1; docs/17): when the fire is first lit on the first evening (intro:curlew), one call far out over the water. Matt chose the frog call the game already has (October 22, 2026) in place of a curlew recording, though frogs have not come on spring day 0. A sound only, not a creature. species: the voice played (src/audio/voices.js); outM: how far out from the camp pad along its seaward line it calls (the adapter puts it there); intensity: the voice's mood, 0..1. The camp fire's own sounds are in recipes/audio/camp.json.
